reasoning_content: pnpm installation via npm -g — it displayed an npm notice, but pnpm isn't on the PATH. Let me check where npm's global bin is located.

action.command: npm config get prefix; ls /usr/local/node-v24.22.0-linux-x64/bin/ | head; ls -la $(npm root -g)/.bin 2>/dev/null | head
